Q5910.reason: Restriction (23) binds later owners with recorded notice under a general plan, so it is enforced in equity as an equitable servitude, since building bans fall outside the traditional negative-easement categories.

Q5623.reason: The footage shows a public protest and the anchorman's remarks are opinion on a matter of public concern, so the professor is unlikely to win a privacy claim.

Q5004.reason: The sister's children's executory interest can vest more than 21 years after the lives in being end, since a child born just before her death might not reach 25 until later, so the Rule Against Perpetuities voids it and the friend keeps the fee simple.
